name: news-market-ai
description: News ingestion -> multi-agent LLM analysis -> trade signal pipeline, deployed on Cloudflare Workers/D1/KV. See plan.md for architecture.

scripts.db:migrate:local:sim: wrangler d1 migrations apply news-market-ai-sim --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply news-market-ai-sim --local -c wrangler.sim-migrate.toml
scripts.db:migrate:remote:sim: wrangler d1 migrations apply news-market-ai-sim --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply news-market-ai-sim --remote -c wrangler.sim-migrate.toml
scripts.db:migrate:local:all: npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:migrate:local:inputs && npm run db:migrate:local:live && npm run db:migrate:local:sim
scripts.db:migrate:remote:all: npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run db:migrate:remote:inputs && npm run db:migrate:remote:live && npm run db:migrate:remote:sim
